attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Hofund
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, this character may Push the defender Away |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Guardian of the Bifrost
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 and Place it within |!range| 2 of its current position. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: All-Seeing Eyes
superPowers.body: When an allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking, defending, or dodging, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. The allied character may reroll up to 2 of its own dice.|\|Alternatively, when an allied character within |!range| 4 rolls dice for a Crisis Card or Team Tactic Card, this character may use this superpower. The allied character may reroll up to 2 of its own dice.

superPowers.name: Forefend
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 2 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Immediately make a |*Strike| attack against the enemy character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
